name: grid
blurb: Static black background with a white grid pattern and vignette fade.
description: CSS-only grid background using a custom grid utility class with a radial gradient mask that fades edges. Includes sample heading text.
use_when: A minimalist dark hero section or full-page background with grid texture.
avoid_when: Requires customization — this is a template component, not a reusable wrapper. No props exposed for colour changes.
a11y: Contains sample text centered with gradient fill; extend by replacing the text content.
